# Edge

Where the outside world comes in. The api package is Loomarr's HTTP surface, and app is the composition root that builds every other area and hands them to it.

One area of the [package map](../package-map.md#start-here).

**Imports from other areas:** any, by design — platform (30), filler (26), library (17), media (12), proposals (11), people (11), channels (10), playout (6)
